prompt: A sample's IR shows a sharp, narrow O–H at ~3620 cm⁻¹. The sample is MOST likely:

options.label: A dilute solution of an alcohol in CCl₄ (isolated, non-H-bonded O–H gives a sharp signal; concentrated or neat gives the broad H-bonded signal).

explanation: Isolated O–H (gas phase or dilute non-polar solvent) is a sharp, narrow band at higher wavenumber (~3620). H-bonded O–H (neat or concentrated) is broader and lower (3200-3550) because the H-bond weakens the O–H bond. This is a diagnostic to tell solvent/concentration effects.
